look_here_first: Look for alternately arranged, rough-surfaced leaves with variable lobes and toothed margins; inspect the underside hairs and mature elongated red-to-purple multiple fruits. Compare cultivated white mulberry and hybrids carefully.
photo_note: One permanent, attributed photo installed for initial visual recognition. Additional anatomy/identity review is necessary; this batch does not determine regional nativity.
identification_caution: Red mulberry vs introduced white mulberry and hybrids requires more than leaf shape; no full diagnostic ID claimed.
